channel.title: Clear English Writing
channel.description: Write clearer English emails and documents at work.

item.title: Affect vs Effect: How to Choose the Right Word at Work
item.description: The simple verb-or-noun test for affect and effect, the rare exceptions that trip up careful writers, and before-and-after fixes from work emails.

item.title: Common Comma Mistakes in Business Writing
item.description: A guide to the comma rules that trip up writers most often at work, based on Cambridge Dictionary grammar guidance and plain language standards.

item.title: Polite Ways to Say No in Business English
item.description: How to decline requests, meetings, and deadlines in English using softened language that stays clear, based on dictionary grammar guidance.

item.title: Short Sentences: What Federal Plain Language Guidelines Recommend
item.description: What official US plain language guidance says about sentence length and structure, with a word count comparison of a before and after rewrite.

item.title: Writing a Clear Request Email
item.description: A guide to writing request emails that are polite, direct, and easy to answer, using dictionary-backed grammar and plain language guidance.
